senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; אהב)love, friendship. א׳ שהיא תלויה בדבר love dependent on something extraneous, i.e. sensual, selfish love.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:16">Aboth V, 16</cite>.—<he>עשה מא׳</he> (or <cite ref="P00014"><he>עבד</he></cite>) to do good (serve the Lord) from pure motives of love.
